groups.sentence: Administrators develop frameworks, policies, guidelines and expectations for AI use in university operations and ensure proposals are reviewed and governed.
Staff check with or consult their supervisor before using AI tools or new AI uses in their roles.
Staff and units may use generative AI for routine administrative and operational tasks such as drafting emails, summarizing meetings and scheduling.
Everyone has a human review AI-generated content for official use before it is sent, published or used.
Everyone follows university communications standards and approval processes for public-facing and official communications and materials.
Safety and surveillance guidelines would benefit from attention to AI-enhanced systems.
Staff and administrators are encouraged to use or explore AI to improve efficiency, administrative processes and decision-making.
Universities support and describe AI efforts to improve efficiency in administrative and student service operations.
Administrators may use AI in institutional functions such as student services, advising, retention and operations, subject to authorization and privacy.
Staff are transparent about how they use AI tools in their work.
Administrators do not use AI for sensitive functions such as legal advice, facial recognition security, vendor bid review or financial and HR projects.
